metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the quarter, the new head on the account, both locks, and evening prayer.

yesterday: Twenty shillings were counted twice, before noon. The receipt is in a law-hand. The firing sixpence stops until Michaelmas.

The coffer, after the rent, is twenty-seven pounds and two shillings. A horn of her ink is twopence and a quire is fivepence. The told sum stays twenty-seven pounds and two shillings. Nineteen pounds and two shillings are under both locks. The belt has the canvas and five pounds. The long page is still on the board.
The chamber stays yours. She will not let it to a preacher. She gave you small beer and her blessing on the road.
You are at St Helen's for the evening of the day, and the bay is still at the Bull.
